description: This file defines the NottableStringMultiMap class, a data structure used within the mockserver project to manage a map of NottableString keys to lists of NottableString values, with support for different key matching styles and subset containment checks.

classes.name: NottableStringMultiMap
classes.description: A map-like data structure that supports complex key matching and subset operations, used in mockserver for request matching and verification.

methods.name: NottableStringMultiMap
methods.description: Constructs a new NottableStringMultiMap with specified entries and key match style.

methods.name: getKeyMatchStyle
methods.description: Returns the key matching style used in this map.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if the current map contains all entries of a subset map, with different matching modes.

methods.name: allKeysNotted
methods.description: Returns true if all keys in the map are 'notted' (negated).

methods.name: allKeysOptional
methods.description: Returns true if all keys in the map are marked as optional.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all values associated with a key, supporting regex matching.

methods.name: entryList
methods.description: Returns a list of all entries in the map as ImmutableEntry objects.
